instruction:
Mirrored Duplex Shell

Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to create a new metric IFC4 one-storey mirrored duplex shell from a blank model. Save the completed model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. The model must contain one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Duplex Level at elevation 0.00 m. Model four spaces, eight walls, one slab, two doors, four windows, six openings, six void relationships, and six fill relationships. Do not include proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique.

Create spaces named A Living, A Bed, B Living, and B Bed. Each space must have clear plan dimensions of 4.80 m by 2.00 m and a height of 2.80 m. Name the slab Duplex Slab and make it 10.40 m by 4.40 m by 0.20 m. Walls must be 3.00 m high with a plan thickness of either 0.15 m or 0.20 m. Include one full-height party wall whose X-axis thickness is no greater than 0.30 m, whose Y-axis length is at least 4.00 m, and whose center X coordinate is within 0.25 m of the midpoint of the Duplex Slab X span. Each door must have OverallWidth 0.95 m and fill one wall opening; each window must have OverallWidth 1.20 m and fill one wall opening. Assign all spaces, walls, the slab, doors, and windows to Duplex Level. Other representation details may vary.
